trophies.guide: The final pop. Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks on its own — there is no shortcut and no separate task behind it. Budget roughly 200 hours in total: the story, the 100% checklist, then the clean-up. Use the roadmap below to work through it in order.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 and it pops when the mission ends. It is the first story beat of the game, so every player earns it just by starting.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. While you are in Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation with Lucia — see Positive Mental Attitude — because that moment does not come back.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Play through Chapter 2 to its final mission and the trophy pops. Chapter 2 is where the game's side activities open up properly, so it is a good time to start the collectible habits in the roadmap.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 3 and it pops at the chapter's end. By now the map is fully open, so use the gaps between missions to work on stunts, vehicle scans and the other counters that feed the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete Chapter 4 and the trophy pops. You are one chapter from the finale at this point — a good moment to check which side-character quest lines are still open, since several only stay available for a while.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish the game's final mission and this gold pops with the credits. There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so anything you have not done by then has to wait for the free-roam after the story — which is fine, because nothing else on this list is locked out.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story and the trophy pops. It is a main-path mission, so it comes to you — just keep playing the story.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete The Cartel Heist, a story heist mission, and the trophy pops when it ends. Heist missions are main-path, so it arrives naturally as you play through the chapters.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the mission Child's Play in the story and the trophy pops. Like the other mission trophies, it is on the main path and cannot be skipped past.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the mission Headliners and the trophy pops. Keep working through the story missions in order and it will come to you.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown and the trophy pops. It is a main-path mission, so there is nothing extra to do beyond playing the story.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory and the trophy pops. It is one of the named story missions, so it arrives as you play through the chapters.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The big one: reach 100% completion, tracked in the game's Progress menu under Stats. The checklist is long — story missions, robberies, bank vaults, gang operations, underwater finds, every Shooting Range gold medal, all drone races, Bret's Target Decks, plus shares of the big counters (100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 100 WAiNK scans). Nothing on it is missable, so it can all be finished in free-roam after the story. See the 100% breakdown in the roadmap below.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, drifts, airtime and the other driving feats the game counts. The fastest way is to chain them while driving between missions rather than hunting them one by one: fast cars, long straight roads and ramps all help, and the counter keeps climbing across the whole playthrough. Note the 100% checklist only needs 300 stunts, so this trophy and that checklist step overlap.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Play one of every activity type the game offers — the races, the Shooting Range, fishing, arcade games, bowling, drone races and the rest. You do not need to win or finish them all, just try each one once. If you are unsure which types you have tried, the activities menu shows what is available; tick them off as you sample each one.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is a skill trophy, not a grind: each challenge has a target score for gold, so replay a challenge until you hit it. Take your time, learn each weapon's handling, and do the easier challenges first — the gold medals also count toward the 100% checklist, so this trophy feeds two goals at once.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of its locations. Drone races are found through the Top Fun activity; win each location's race at least once. Learn the course on a practice run, then race it for the win — the trophy needs a win at every location, not just one.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Work through the race types across the map: street races, off-road, boat and air races where they exist. Winning a race you have already won does not add to the count, so keep moving to new events.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot, take the challenge, and out-fish him. Fishing is a timing game — watch the line, reel in the window the game shows you, and do not rush it. One win against Cal is all it takes.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Walk into an arcade, pick a cabinet, and play it through to the end. Any game counts and any difficulty counts — this is a one-and-done trophy, so take the shortest game you can find.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Side-story trophy, cannot be missed by playing the story alone — but Andy's missions are optional, so you have to seek them out. Follow Andy's quest line through to its final mission and the trophy pops. Character quests are often only offered for a while, so take Andy's missions when they appear instead of leaving them for later.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Side-story trophy. Follow Kenton's quest line to its final mission and the trophy pops. Like the other character quests, Kenton's missions appear as optional markers — pick them up when they show up rather than assuming they will wait.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Side-story trophy. Follow Billy's quest line through to its final mission and the trophy pops. Billy's missions are optional side content, so watch for the marker and take the missions as they appear.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as question-mark markers on the map — talk to the stranger, do their strand, and move on to the next. Eight strands is the count; there are more strangers than that in the state, so you do not need every single one. Partly unconfirmed at launch: the exact count of available strands is still being mapped by players, so work through every marker you find.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Side-story trophy. Follow Randy's quest line to its final mission and the trophy pops. Randy's missions are optional, so take them when they appear on the map rather than leaving them for the endgame.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Side-story trophy. Follow Tyrone's quest line through to its final mission and the trophy pops. As with the other character quests, the missions are optional markers — do them when they show up.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. THE possibly missable trophy: the first spot is the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia, the morning after the mission Down to Earth — follow her from the kitchen to the balcony and accept it. That moment is gone after Chapter 1, so do it on your first playthrough. The other spots are spread across the state; the 100% checklist needs 15 of 18 meditations, so this trophy and that step overlap. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter as insurance.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand asks you to track down a specific rare animal — follow his missions, use the binoculars to study animals as you go, and take the shot when the unique animal is identified. Partly unconfirmed at launch: which animal and where it appears is still being pinned down by players, so follow Bret's quest markers and the in-game hints rather than a fixed map pin.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida as a collectible; a set is complete when you hold every card in it. Pick up every card you pass — the map markers and a collectible checklist help — and three full sets is the target. Cards also appear in Bret's Target Decks, which tie into the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan at 100 locations across Leonida. WAiNK is the in-game scanning app — open it at a location, scan, and move on. The habit that works is scanning everywhere you already go: every new place you visit is a free scan. The 100% checklist also needs 100 WAiNK scans, so this trophy and that step are the same work.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind. Challenges are the small objectives scattered through the game's activities and world — stunts, races, shooting, exploration and more. Just play broadly and the count climbs; the 100% checklist needs 70 of 80 challenges, so pushing past 50 keeps paying off.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. The trick is the escape, not the wanted level: get the heat, then break line of sight, switch vehicles, and use alleys and the countryside to drop the stars. Do it with your partner in the car — the trophy needs both of you there.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops one after another without losing your wanted level between them. Plan a route through three close shops, hit them fast, and keep moving — the wanted level has to stay alive across all three robberies. If the stars drop, the chain breaks and you start over.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Getting in a new vehicle counts as discovering it, so drive everything you see — cars, bikes, boats, aircraft. The 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 vehicle scans, so the habit of driving new vehicles pays off twice. Rare vehicles count the same as common ones, so volume beats rarity here.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a crowd of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends. Pick a busy shootout rather than a quiet one — more targets in the window means more chances. Ammo and cover help: stay alive long enough to finish all five.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — Vice City International Airport. In plain terms: steal a plane at the airport and take off without a ticket. Get to the airfield, grab a plane, and get airborne. Expect a wanted level on the way in, so go in fast and get off the ground quickly.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get inside a Rhino tank. Rhinos are military vehicles, so they show up around military areas and high-wanted-level responses — steal one when you get the chance and the trophy pops once you are in the driver's seat. At higher wanted levels the army rolls out, which is the most reliable way to find one.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. This is a stealth robbery: get in, take the goods, and get out before anyone spots you or raises the alarm. Plan the approach, watch the staff and cameras, and leave quietly — if you are detected, the attempt fails and you try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults are the big robberies: plan the entry, crack the vault, and get out clean. Five separate vaults, five escapes — each one counts on its own. These also feed the 100% checklist, so do them as part of the robbery sweep rather than as a separate chore.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around the state — spot one, stop it, take the cash, and get away before the police close in. One successful truck robbery and escape is all it takes.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — every region of the state. Drive, fly and sail across the map until the fog lifts everywhere: Vice City, the beaches, the swamps, the Keys and the countryside. The trophy pops when the last unexplored corner is visited. Pair it with the collectible hunts so the exploring does double duty.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in the state. Every gang runs its own operations — find one per gang, hit it, and move to the next. The trophy needs one robbery per gang, not every operation, so map the gangs first and work through them one by one. These also count toward the 100% checklist's gang-operation step.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet at launch. The description points to Ocean Beach — a cocktail with a view — so the likely shape is a specific bar or spot on the beachfront, but players have not pinned down which one or what triggers it. Do not chase a guessed location: check back once the community confirms it, and this guide will be updated. The trophy is hidden on PlayStation until earned.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet at launch. The description suggests driving a car out through a vehicle showroom's window or wall, in the style of a classic GTA moment — but which showroom and what exactly triggers it is not confirmed. It is hidden on PlayStation until earned, and guessing wrong wastes time, so this guide names it unconfirmed rather than inventing a location.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — play a game of bowling there. The trophy's wording points to a full follow-through at that specific alley, so play a proper game rather than a single throw. It is a hidden trophy, so it stays masked here until you earn it or switch spoilers on.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A hidden trophy whose description reads like a riddle: a partnership with mass appeal. The likeliest reading is a co-op-flavoured moment with your partner that the wider world notices — but the exact trigger is not nailed down at launch. Treat it as a story-adjacent secret and keep playing; this guide will be updated when players confirm it.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: A hidden trophy about a choice: make a decision in the story and live with it. The description deliberately gives nothing away, so the trigger is a story choice rather than a location or a counter. Play the story, make the choice when it comes, and the trophy pops — there is nothing to grind for it.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet at launch. The description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something — but at what, and where, is not confirmed. It is hidden on PlayStation until earned. This guide says so plainly instead of guessing: check back once players confirm the trigger.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet at launch. The description reads like a reaction to something strange — an easter egg or a weird world event — but what it is and where it happens is not confirmed. Hidden on PlayStation until earned. Like the other unconfirmed secrets, this one is listed as unknown rather than guessed at.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet at launch. The wording suggests a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a melee weapon — and the bowling name ties it to the bowling alley, but the exact spot and trigger are not confirmed. Hidden on PlayStation until earned; this guide will be updated when players pin it down.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — they are dirty money that has to be cleaned through contacts before it counts as yours. Keep robbing, keep laundering, and the counter climbs. Big heists and bank vaults are the fastest source of bills to clean.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Everything you buy counts — weapons, clothes, cars, food, ammo. It adds up naturally over a full playthrough, but if you are close at the end, the fastest way to finish it is buying big-ticket items like vehicles and property upgrades. There is no penalty for spending, so do not hoard cash for this one.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in the game. Garages are properties you purchase with clean money — work through the property listings, buy each garage, and the trophy pops when the last one is yours. It pairs naturally with Treat Yo Self, since the purchases count toward the $100,000 spending total too.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app lets you register vehicles you own — open it, register a vehicle, and repeat until ten are on the books. Any ten vehicles count, so register the ones you already drive rather than buying new ones for it.
trophies.name: On the Spot
